sources.h1: Cranetortoise by Albit - SW-1 Switching Distortion
sources.excerpt:
- **Builder:** Cranetortoise by Albit
- **Catalog identity:** SW-1 Switching Distortion
- **Catalog type:** Distortion / Modulation
- **Identity:** Exact Cranetortoise / Albit SW-1.

SW-1 is an analog switching-distortion effect from the Cranetortoise/ALBIT range. Surviving exact-model documentation describes selectable gain-overdrive/distortion and a separate switching/tremolo-style sound that can also be combined with the distortion.

- The exact-model Reverb listing describes selectable:
  - gain overdrive or distortion
  - tremolo / “scatter gun” delay-echo style switching effects
  - or a combination of both
- A complete verified knob-label/value transcription was not established.

- **SW-1B Switching Distortion for Bass** is a separate bass-oriented catalog model.
- SW-1 itself is documented as an analog 1980s Japanese pedal in surviving Reverb data.

- 9V battery or 9V adapter.

- Exact transistor type or part number: **not established**.

- Exact diode type or part number: **not established**.

SW-1 combines conventional gain-based distortion with a switchable rhythmic/switching effect. The checked period listing specifically describes machine-like scatter-gun, delay-echo and tremolo-style textures when the switching section is engaged.

- Made in Japan.
- Reverb identifies the pedal as a boutique analog switching distortion from the 1980s.

- Exact-model Reverb: https://reverb.com/item/17278924-albit-cranetortoise-sw-1-switching-distortion-effect-pedal
- Effects Database family listing: https://www.effectsdatabase.com/model/cranetortoise
- Encores exact-model listing: https://encores.jp/effector_category/cranetortoise
- ALBIT official support: https://www.albit.jp/support.html
